Mid-State Technical College // IT Department PixelBoof AI Booth ATTENDEE GUIDE — PAGE 1
BOOTH HELPER PLAYBOOK STAFF & VOLUNTEERS ONLY

RUNNING THE PIXEL BOOF STATION

Our mission: Help attendees create their custom AI stickers, batch-transfer their top 3 picks to the Shared Drive, and keep the Cricut print queue running smoothly!

1. Station Helper Loop (Station PCs → Shared Google Drive)

Step A: Enforce the 3-Sticker Cap

Students can snap several test photos, but they may only queue up to 3 stickers for printing. The updated app blocks adding a 4th sticker to the queue automatically.

Step B: Tag Name & School + Download Batch

Open Gallery → Sticker Queue, verify their Name & High School are filled in, and click Download Batch (X/3). It saves a ready-to-sort ZIP/PNG batch!

Step C: Upload Batch to Shared Drive & Click “Next Attendee”

Drop the downloaded batch into the PixelBoof Shared Google Drive folder so Blu can pull it on the Cricut station for printing and cutting. Then click 🔄 Next Attendee inside the Sticker Queue modal to reset the station back to 0/3 for the next kid!

2. Booth Pacing, Break Rotation & Bus Cutoff Schedule

• Break & Group Photo Window: About 15 minutes before the group photo (and for a mid-day break), pause new Shared Drive batches so Blu can catch up on the Cricut queue, take a breather, and join the group photo!

• Hard Bus Cutoff (35 Minutes Before Departure): Stop sending new print batches to the Shared Drive 35 minutes before the buses leave. Students can still use the booth and save digital stickers to their phones via QR/Share, but the Cricut queue closes so Blu has time to finish printing and cutting every batch before the buses depart!

3. Mobile QR Code & Cloud Run Cost Protection

• Event-Time Mobile Access: Kids can scan the booth QR code (which includes ?pass=TECHCON26) to run PixelBoof on their phones while in line and AirDrop/upload their top 3 PNGs to a helper.

• Post-Event Shutdown: Because PixelBoof is hosted on Google Cloud Run, we run scripts/lock-booth.bat as soon as Tech-Con wraps to revoke public Cloud Run access so nobody can use the URL after hours.

HOW TO LET KIDS USE CELLPHONES SAFELY

3-LAYER CLOUD RUN WALLET PROTECTION

Since your Gemini API key is baked into the client build on Google Cloud Run and paid out of your own pocket, if high schoolers scan a QR code on their phones, that URL stays in their mobile browser history after they get on the bus. Here is the 3-layer defense built into your updated zip (PixelBoof-MSTC-Updated.zip):

1. Event Pass & Hours Gate

The app checks VITE_EVENT_START_HOUR / END_HOUR & ?pass=TECHCON26 before calling Gemini.

2. 1-Click Cloud Run Lock

Run scripts/lock-booth.bat when buses leave to remove allUsers invoker access ($0 cost).

3. AI Studio Quota Cap

Rotate/disable the API key in Google AI Studio or set a hard daily spend cap in GCP Billing.

CUSTOMIZE BOOTH QR URL

Update your Cloud Run URL or event pass below to regenerate the printable booth QR badge:

POST-EVENT KILL SWITCH (CLI)

Run this command when Tech-Con ends to block all phone traffic at Google’s edge for $0.00:

gcloud run services remove-iam-policy-binding pixelbooth --member="allUsers" --role="roles/run.invoker" --region=us-central1

🎟️ STICKER QUEUE (0/3 MAX)

Strict 3-sticker limit per person. Enter your Name & High School so our helpers can send your batch to the Cricut!
